name: Integration for WooCommerce – Zoho CRM, Books, Invoice, Inventory, Desk, Campaigns, Bigin
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
Integrazo connects your WooCommerce store with all major Zoho products. Automatically sync orders, customers, and products to Zoho without any manual data entry.

Whether you’re managing sales in Zoho CRM, sending invoices through Zoho Books or Zoho Invoice, tracking stock in Zoho Inventory, handling support in Zoho Desk, running email campaigns via Zoho Campaigns, or managing pipelines in Zoho Bigin — Integrazo keeps everything in sync in real time.

Why store owners choose Integrazo:

  • ✅ One plugin for all 7 Zoho products
  • ✅ Secure OAuth authentication — no passwords stored
  • ✅ Flexible field mapping — you control how data is sent
  • ✅ Detailed sync logs with one-click retry for failed records
  • ✅ Email alerts when a sync fails
  • ✅ No sync limits on the free version

Getting started takes just 4 steps:
1. Select WooCommerce as your data source
2. Choose a Zoho product as the destination
3. Authenticate your Zoho account via OAuth
4. Map your WooCommerce fields to Zoho fields and save

Supported Zoho Products

Zoho CRM
Sync WooCommerce customers and orders to Zoho CRM. Create or update Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals, and Sales Orders automatically when an order is placed in your store.

Zoho Books
Send WooCommerce order data to Zoho Books. Create Contacts, Sales Orders, or Invoices with full line item details, taxes, shipping, and customer billing information.

Zoho Invoice
Automatically generate Zoho Invoice records from WooCommerce orders. Create Customers and Invoices with complete order data including products, quantities, and tax details.

Zoho Inventory
Keep your Zoho Inventory in sync with WooCommerce. Sync orders and products to Contacts, Items, and Sales Orders in Zoho Inventory based on your store activity.

Zoho Desk
Convert WooCommerce orders or customer events into Zoho Desk Tickets or Contacts. Automate your support workflow so your team is notified the moment a customer needs help.

Zoho Campaigns
Add WooCommerce customers to your Zoho Campaigns mailing lists automatically. Build targeted email audiences from buyers without any manual import.

Zoho Bigin
Push WooCommerce customers and orders into Zoho Bigin pipelines. Create Contacts, Companies, and Deals to manage your sales pipeline directly from store data.

Field Mapping

Map any WooCommerce data field to the corresponding Zoho field:

  • Order details (ID, status, date, total, taxes, shipping)
  • Customer details (name, email, phone, billing address, shipping address)
  • Product line items (name, SKU, quantity, price)
  • Custom values and system fields

Sync Logs

Every sync is recorded so you always know what happened:

  • View SUCCESS and RECORD_FAILED statuses
  • See the full API request and response for each record
  • Filter logs by integration, status, or date range
  • Retry failed records with one click

Free vs Pro

Free Version — No limits, no time restrictions:
– Unlimited integrations
– Add-only record creation
– Custom values and system fields
– Retry failed records
– Email notifications for failed syncs

Pro Version — Advanced features:
– Add and update existing records (no duplicates)
– Advanced filter conditions (sync only specific orders/customers)
– File attachments to Zoho records
– Tags and notes support
– Custom and premium Zoho fields
– Multiple Zoho account support
– Extended log retention and management

Upgrade to Pro at integrazo.com

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to the following external services to function:

  • Zoho API (zoho.com, zohoapis.com, accounts.zoho.com) — Used to authenticate your Zoho account via OAuth 2.0 and send WooCommerce data to your selected Zoho product. Zoho Privacy Policy | Zoho Terms of Service

Data is only transmitted to Zoho when a WooCommerce event (order, customer, product) triggers a configured integration. No data is sent to Integrazo servers.

Support

  • Documentation: https://integrazo.com/products/woocommerce-zoho-integration
  • Support: https://integrazo.com/pages/contact
  • Feature Requests: https://integrazo.com/pages/request-feature
  • Email: support@integrazo.com
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard
2. Search for Integrazo
3. Click Install Now and then Activate
4. Go to the Integrazo menu and complete the setup

Manual Installation
1. Download the plugin ZIP file
2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin
3. Upload the ZIP and click Install Now
4. Activate the plugin
5. Go to the Integrazo menu and complete the setup
sections.faq:
Which WooCommerce data can be synced?

You can sync WooCommerce orders, customers, and products — including billing details, shipping details, line items, taxes, and order totals — to any supported Zoho product.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce to Zoho CRM integration?

Yes. WooCommerce orders and customers can be synced to Zoho CRM as Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Deals, or Sales Orders. You control how fields are mapped.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce to Zoho Books integration?

Yes. WooCommerce orders are sent to Zoho Books as Contacts, Sales Orders, or Invoices — with full line items, taxes, and customer details.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce to Zoho Invoice integration?

Yes. WooCommerce orders can automatically create Customers and Invoices in Zoho Invoice, including product line items and tax data.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce to Zoho Inventory integration?

Yes. Sync WooCommerce orders and products to Zoho Inventory as Contacts, Items, or Sales Orders based on your setup.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce to Zoho Desk integration?

Yes. WooCommerce order or customer data can create Tickets or Contacts in Zoho Desk, making it easy to automate support workflows.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce to Zoho Campaigns integration?

Yes. Automatically add WooCommerce customers to Zoho Campaigns mailing lists when they place an order or register.

Does this plugin support WooCommerce to Zoho Bigin integration?

Yes. WooCommerce customers and orders can be pushed to Zoho Bigin as Contacts, Companies, or Deals to manage your sales pipeline.

Can I disable an integration without deleting it?

Yes. Each integration can be toggled on or off from the Setup page without losing any configuration or mapping.

What happens if a record fails to sync?

Failed records are stored in the Logs page with the full API error response. You can review the reason, fix the issue, and retry syncing with one click.

Does this plugin support multiple Zoho accounts?

Multiple Zoho account support is available in the Pro version. The free version supports one Zoho account per product.

Does this plugin work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes. Integrazo is compatible with WordPress multisite installations.

Is my Zoho account data safe?

Yes. Authentication uses Zoho’s official OAuth 2.0 flow. Your Zoho credentials are never stored in the plugin or on Integrazo servers.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No. Setup is done entirely through a visual interface — select your source, destination, map fields, and save.
